ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The figure is a transition-state schematic with multiple curved arrows; the left side is labeled Et3N:, and on the right there is an H—NEt3 positively charged fragment. The main structure contains a six-membered-ring aromatic/imine-like skeleton, with an exocyclic =NH/imine feature; on the right it is connected to a carbonyl C=O, with R labeled below the carbonyl; the carbon adjacent to the left of the carbonyl is connected to a methylthio substituent S–CH3. Reasoning: According to the problem statement, ignore all curved arrows and retain only the covalent skeleton. The unspecified acyl substituent R is represented with a wildcard, written as *C(=O). Continue to the carbonyl-adjacent carbon bearing the methylthio group, written as C(SC). This carbon is then connected to the six-membered aromatic/imine ring in the figure, which can be written as C1C=CC=CC1=N. The Et3N/NEt3 in the figure, as an amine fragment disconnected from the main structure, is separated with a dot and written as CCN(CC)C as specified. Therefore the overall SMILES is *C(=O)C(SC)C1C=CC=CC1=N.CCN(CC)C.

method.method_draft: First visually strip away all curved arrows from the transition-state drawing. Then trace the covalent skeleton from the unspecified acyl substituent R: write the wildcard acyl group as `*C(=O)`, continue to the adjacent carbon bearing the methylthio group as `C(SC)`, then attach this to the six-membered aryl/imino ring read from the drawing as `C1C=CC=CC1=N`. Finally add the disconnected amine fragment indicated by the Et3N/NEt3 label using a dot separator. This gives `*C(=O)C(SC)C1C=CC=CC1=N.CCN(CC)C`.
method.CoT_raw: 图像描述：图中是一个带有多条弯曲箭头的过渡态示意图；左侧标有 Et3N:，右侧有 H—NEt3 带正电的片段。主体结构包含一个六元环的芳香/亚胺样骨架，环外有 =NH/亚胺特征；右侧连有羰基 C=O，羰基下方标 R；羰基左侧相邻碳连有一个甲硫基取代基 S–CH3。推理：按题意忽略所有弯曲箭头，只保留共价骨架。从未指定的酰基取代基 R 用通配符表示，写作 *C(=O)。继续到羰基相邻、带甲硫基的碳，写作 C(SC)。该碳再连接到图中的六元芳香/亚胺环，可写成 C1C=CC=CC1=N。图中 Et3N/NEt3 作为与主体结构断开的胺片段，用点号分隔，按指定写作 CCN(CC)C。因此整体 SMILES 为 *C(=O)C(SC)C1C=CC=CC1=N.CCN(CC)C。

planner_metadata.text_role: Use the question text only to determine the task constraints: produce a SMILES expression for the shown transition-state structure and explicitly ignore the arrows.
planner_metadata.knowledge_role: Apply SMILES conventions: represent the unspecified R attachment as wildcard `*`, encode the carbonyl as `C(=O)`, encode methylthio as `SC`, encode the imino aryl ring as `C1C=CC=CC1=N`, and separate disconnected molecular components with a dot. Use the expected abbreviation expansion for the amine fragment as `CCN(CC)C`.
